# Collateral balance (`collateral-balance` v1)

Collateral held and posted under a CSA, by asset, after haircuts.

**Group:** Collateral and margin · **Mnemonic:** `COLL` · **Identifiers:** `COLL-…` in `balanceId`

Open one with `COLL <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: collateral-balance
version: 1
description: "Collateral held and posted under a CSA, by asset, after haircuts."
match: { kind: collateral-balance, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Collateral and margin · Collateral balance, id: $.balanceId }
strip:
  - { label: Held, bind: $.held, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Posted, bind: $.posted, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Net, bind: $.net, fmt: signed0, tone: sign, emphasis: true }
  - { label: As of, bind: $.asOf, fmt: date }
panels:
  - id: positions
    kind: table
    title: Positions
    key: F2
    rows: $.positions
    columns:
      - { label: Asset, bind: "@.asset" }
      - { label: Direction, bind: "@.direction" }
      - { label: Market value, bind: "@.marketValue", fmt: amount0, total: true }
      - { label: Haircut, bind: "@.haircut", fmt: pct2 }
      - { label: Collateral value, bind: "@.value", fmt: amount0, total: true }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.csa, 'csa')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
